# Definition lists


```````````````````````````````` example
Term
: definition
.
Document scope=1:1..2:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── DefinitionList scope=1:1..2:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Definition scope=1:1..2:12 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=1
        ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
        │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Term" children=0
        └── DefinitionBody children=1
            └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
                └── Text scope=2:3..2:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="definition" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## def-div-boundary

```````````````````````````````` example
::: {.box}
Term
: body
:::
after
.
Document scope=1:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── DirectiveBlock scope=1:1..4:3 anchor=null attributes={.box} name=null children=1
│   └── DefinitionList scope=2:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Definition scope=2:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=1
│           ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
│           │   └── Text scope=2:1..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Term" children=0
│           └── DefinitionBody children=1
│               └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│                   └── Text scope=3:3..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="after" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## body-list-fence

```````````````````````````````` example
Term
: body
- list

T
: d
```
x
```
.
Document scope=1:1..9:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
├── DefinitionList scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Definition scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=1
│       ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
│       │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Term" children=0
│       └── DefinitionBody children=1
│           └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│               └── Text scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
├── List scope=3:1..4:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=3:1..4:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=3:3..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="list" children=0
├── DefinitionList scope=5:1..6:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Definition scope=5:1..6:3 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=1
│       ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
│       │   └── Text scope=5:1..5:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="T" children=0
│       └── DefinitionBody children=1
│           └── Paragraph scope=6:3..6:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│               └── Text scope=6:3..6:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d" children=0
└── CodeBlock scope=7:1..9:3 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="x\n" fenced=true closed=true children=0
````````````````````````````````

## body-shapes

```````````````````````````````` example
Term
: first

  > [!NOTE] Title
  > body

  - list

  | a | b |
  | - | - |
  | c | d |

Other

~ last
.
Document scope=1:1..15:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── DefinitionList scope=1:1..15:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Definition scope=1:1..11:11 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=1
    │   ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
    │   │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Term" children=0
    │   └── DefinitionBody children=4
    │       ├── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=2:3..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first" children=0
    │       ├── Callout scope=4:3..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant="NOTE" collapsed=null children=1
    │       │   ├── Title children=1
    │       │   │   └── Text scope=4:13..4:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Title" children=0
    │       │   └── Paragraph scope=5:5..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │       └── Text scope=5:5..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
    │       ├── List scope=7:3..8:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    │       │   └── ListItem scope=7:3..8:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │       │       └── Paragraph scope=7:5..7:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │           └── Text scope=7:5..7:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="list" children=0
    │       └── Table scope=9:3..11:11 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
    │           ├── TableHead children=1
    │           │   └── TableRow scope=9:3..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │           │       ├── TableCell scope=9:4..9:6 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           │       │   └── Text scope=9:5..9:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │           │       └── TableCell scope=9:8..9:10 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           │           └── Text scope=9:9..9:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    │           ├── TableBody children=1
    │           │   └── TableRow scope=11:3..11:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │           │       ├── TableCell scope=11:4..11:6 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           │       │   └── Text scope=11:5..11:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
    │           │       └── TableCell scope=11:8..11:10 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           │           └── Text scope=11:9..11:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d" children=0
    │           └── TableFoot children=0
    └── Definition scope=13:1..15:6 anchor=null attributes={} compact=false children=1
        ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
        │   └── Text scope=13:1..13:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Other" children=0
        └── DefinitionBody children=1
            └── Paragraph scope=15:3..15:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
                └── Text scope=15:3..15:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="last" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
: second

    ├── Definition scope=1:1..4:8 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=2
    │   ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
    │   │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="T" children=0
    │   ├── DefinitionBody children=0
    │   └── DefinitionBody children=1
    │       └── Paragraph scope=4:3..4:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │           └── Text scope=4:3..4:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="second" children=0
    └── Definition scope=6:1..7:1 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=1
        ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
        │   └── Text scope=6:1..6:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="U" children=0
        └── DefinitionBody children=0
````````````````````````````````

## references

```````````````````````````````` example
[x]: /u
: text

Term
: [x] @key

Term\
: body
.
Document scope=1:1..8:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=2:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=2:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=": text" children=0
└── DefinitionList scope=4:1..8:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Definition scope=4:1..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=1
    │   ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
    │   │   └── Text scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Term" children=0
    │   └── DefinitionBody children=1
    │       └── Paragraph scope=5:3..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │           ├── Link scope=5:3..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("/u") title=null children=1
    │           │   └── Text scope=5:4..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    │           ├── Text scope=5:6..5:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    │           └── Cite scope=5:7..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │               └── Citation scope=5:7..5:10 referent=bib(key="key",mode=authorInText) children=0
    │                   ├── CitationPrefix children=0
    │                   └── CitationSuffix children=0
    └── Definition scope=7:1..8:6 anchor=null attributes={} compact=true children=1
        ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
        │   └── Text scope=7:1..7:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Term\\" children=0
        └── DefinitionBody children=1
            └── Paragraph scope=8:3..8:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
                └── Text scope=8:3..8:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````
